name: Fukigen na Ane
source:
Sister is so beautiful and cool, but at the same really selfish and naughty. When the secret word is murmured, it's the time to become a dog for her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
姐姐美丽又冷酷，却也自私又淘气。当低声说出暗语时，就是变成她的狗的时候。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
